preconditions.description: The length of the text string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the pattern string pat must be between 1 and the length of the text string S.
Both S and pat must be strings.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(S) for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: All returned indices must be within the bounds of the text string S.

postconditions.expression: all(S[index-1:index-1+len(pat)] == pat for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each returned index must correspond to the start of an occurrence of the pattern string pat in S.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == 0 if pat not in S else len(return_value) > 0
postconditions.description: If the pattern string pat is not found in S, the return value must be an empty list; otherwise, it must contain at least one index.
